limitations: Not deployed or released to phones in this record
Physical notification delivery, camera and microphone, 72-hour background result and three business workflows remain pending
Notification history is bounded to 24 hours/64 records per AI; gaps and platform-redacted content are explicit
Polling requires the personal AI scheduler; creating a watch does not start autonomous execution
Event deduplication does not replace source-App business identifier reconciliation or provide end-to-end exactly-once effects
